Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11

Class X11FixesExt.CursorNotifyEvent

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.Data
gnu.x11.event.Event
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11.X11FixesExt.CursorNotifyEvent
Enclosing class:
X11FixesExt
public static class X11FixesExt.CursorNotifyEvent extends gnu.x11.event.Event
XFixes CursorNotify event (event code first_event + 1). Delivered after X11FixesExt.selectCursorInput(gnu.x11.Window, int) when the cursor image changes. 
 typedef struct {
     CARD8   type;             // 0
     CARD8   subtype;          // 1  (SetCursorNotify = 0)
     CARD16  sequenceNumber;   // 2
     Window  window;           // 4
     CARD32  cursorSerial;     // 8
     Time    timestamp;        // 12
     Atom    name;             // 16  (XFixes 2.0+)
     CARD32  pad1;             // 20
 } xXFixesCursorNotifyEvent;
